blends.name: How to become an Engineer
blends.desc:
The "[Old Book Page - 1x](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/606491)" NFTs introduced with the "[The Great Storm](https://waxel.net/the-great-storm/)" event can be used to blend one of the following profession books:

- [How to become a Miner](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540983)
- [How to become a Lumberjack](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540984)
- [How to become a Farmer](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540985)
- [How to become a Blacksmith](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540986)
- [How to become a Carpenter](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540987)
- [How to become a Tailor](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540988)
- [How to become an Engineer](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/waxelninjas1/540989)

You are going to need 7 "Old Book Page - 1x" NFTs in order to blend the respective profession book.
